accepted_scope_caveats.label: Open-ended Question 1 and Theorem 4
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The smooth-splice collision experiment, including fixed-class membership and product-TV control, is assumed only conditionally and remains an explicit open construction.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The matching covariance/fiber minimax lower bound and honest-diameter conclusion hold conditional on an affirmative smooth-splice construction; the upper whole-fiber result is unconditional.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Complete the smooth-splice construction with explicit density-positivity, divisor-maximality, envelope, moment, and weighted-Plancherel constants, converting the conditional converse into a matched fixed-class result.
Add a worked three-variable literal-Laplace numerical instance that computes the two ideal branches, the collision path, and the finite-sample interval union from observable moments.
State a short transfer corollary that explicitly maps each Cholesky factor to its compatible reduced-form mixed-noise SCM, making the causal interpretation of the fiber immediately auditable.

recommended_next_step: Advance to Stage 0 with the smooth-splice construction retained as an accepted conditional open target; prioritize its fixed-class verification for the matched-rate upgrade.
